An energy revolution is underway in Iran, positioning renewable energy at the forefront of the country’s energy supply.

With an ambitious target of installing 30 GW of renewable energy capacity by 2030, Iran has a significant opportunity to address inequalities, support workers and industries, and promote economic diversification by catalyzing transformative change.

Our sessions in Tehran with high-level representatives from Iran's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Ministry of Energy led to a productive exchange of actionable strategies for advancing a just energy transition:

1.⁠ Develop regulatory frameworks, enhance skills training for workers, and create targeted support systems to ensure a just transition
2.⁠ ⁠Scale sustainable finance through supportive policies that unlock investment in renewables and enhance energy efficiency
3.⁠ ⁠Leverage digital innovation and AI to optimize systems and enable data-driven policymaking within broader socio-economic contexts

This journey will be driven by the convergence of digitalization, market development, policy, and governance. 💡

#EnergyForDevelopment ⚡️
